what: On first open, over a plate covering the screen, letters come in one at a time alternately from above and below (.7s) and a number counts from 00 to 100 over 1.4s. Then the letters exit the opposite way (.5s), the number disappears and the plate lifts away. Only once per window

options.text: Text on the panel, default ”Almost there”
options.every: If present, every time it opens (not just once)
options.dur: Duration (seconds) for the number to count from 00 to 100, default 1.4
options.in: Length of the text entrance (seconds), default 0.7 — the exit starts after the numbers finish counting, so in + each × (character count − 1) must fit within dur
options.each: Gap between letters (seconds), default 0.03 (⅔ when leaving). The panel takes dur + out + each × ⅔ × (letter count − 1) seconds to clear (about 2s for the default 8-letter text), and then fx:loaded fires

use: <div data-fx="count-loader" data-fx-count-loader="text: Almost there; dur: 0.4; in: 0.2; out: 0.15; each: 0.01"> — When finished, an fx:loaded event fires on document. Default is the original length (about 2s)
